name: globevoy-budget-travel-709a
description: Read-only budget-first trip discovery from Globevoy with explicit price basis and evidence labels.
long_description: Private GV-DIST-709A prototype for testing Globevoy as an AI distribution connector. It searches the existing Globevoy staging recommendation surfaces and returns a small set of single-city and multi-city options with explicit total-trip budget semantics, evidence labels, and an external-handoff-only booking boundary. It does not book, pay, reserve, sign in, or modify accounts.

tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Search Globevoy for a small budget-first set of trip recommendations. Prices state their basis and evidence status; no booking, payment, reservation, or account mutation occurs.
